name: Iraq

nso.name: Central Statistical Organization (CSO / COSIT), Ministry of Planning

latest_census.notes: General Population and Housing Census, 20-22 November 2024 -- the first nationwide count since 1987 (1997 excluded the Kurdistan Region). Preliminary results 25 November 2024; final results announced by the Minister of Planning on 24 February 2025 (INA; 46,118,793 incl. foreign residents, 45,778,662 excluding them). Sources conflict on the religion item: Rudaw Research Center says 'there are questions regarding religion ... the form does not address issues of ethnicity, language, or sect', Shafaq News reports 'exclusion of sect and ethnicity', Al Jazeera/others say the census 'does include religion information, though it does not differentiate between sects'; Esri ArcNews (Winter 2026) says 'no questions about ethnicity or religion'. The weight of reporting is: religion asked, sect not, ethnicity not, language not. No governorate-level religion table was found in any result. INA: 'All governorate-level data sets have been finalized and will be delivered to provincial authorities, covering districts, sub-districts, villages...' (population and housing, not religion, as far as the snippets show). One snippet says more detailed final results were released in November 2025; not verified.

tier_reason: Ethnicity and language were deliberately excluded from the 2024 questionnaire (Shafaq, Rudaw Research Center, Esri ArcNews all agree), so the right output for those two fields is a not_collected declaration citing the 2024 census. Religion was asked (sect was not) but no governorate-level religion publication was found on cosit.gov.iq, HDX or anywhere else, so that single field is a D within a C country: asked, publication not established.
recommended_action: Declare ethnicity and language not_collected for Iraq with the 2024 census as evidence (questionnaire excluded ethnicity, language and sect). Keep religion open: check COSIT's census pages and the Annual Abstract 2024 chapter 2 for a religion-by-governorate table once the detailed volumes are out (the Ministry said governorate datasets were finalised in February 2025; one report says detailed results came in November 2025), and note the CSO will not publish Sunni/Shia. Also check the Kurdistan Region Statistics Office (KRSO, not searched) for the four northern governorates. Do not fill from 1987/1997 census figures or from Wikipedia narrative without seeing a table. HDX cod-ps-irq gives the same 18/101 structure as the boundary and is the join key to use if a table appears.

summary: Iraq's November 2024 census -- the first full count since 1987 -- excluded ethnicity, language and sect from the questionnaire by political decision, so those fields should be declared not_collected with the 2024 census cited. Religion was asked (Christians, Yazidis, Mandaeans etc., but no Sunni/Shia split), yet no governorate table of it surfaced on COSIT's site, in the Annual Abstract chapter, on HDX, or in the press coverage of the February 2025 final results. HDX's COD-PS carries exactly the boundary's 18 governorates and 101 districts and is the join key if a religion table appears. Wikipedia district articles exist for the sampled shapes but their snippets are narrative, not tables.
